scope: Source code, datasets, static resources and training interfaces. Recorded experiment outputs are excluded.

toxipep.name: ToxiPep
toxipep.selection: Historical workflows include validation-Accuracy selection and external-test-Accuracy scanning; the corresponding run records are not included in this code release.

toxteller.name: ToxTeller
toxteller.selection: Fitted LR, RF, SVM, and XGBoost classifiers
toxteller.dependencies: scikit-learn, XGBoost, NumPy, pandas; a fitted scaler is required for inference

toxmsrc.name: ToxMSRC
toxmsrc.selection: Historical PyTorch summaries used validation Accuracy
toxmsrc.dependencies: PyTorch, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; Word2Vec feature generation requires gensim; the original Keras workflow also requires TensorFlow

plptp.name: PLPTP
plptp.dependencies: PyTorch, transformers, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; local model definitions are in local_models/

captp.name: CAPTP
captp.dependencies: PyTorch, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; the accompanying AAindex vocabulary is in data/

toxgin.name: ToxGIN
toxgin.dependencies: PyTorch, DGL, transformers, tokenizers, Biopandas, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; the optional PyG interface also requires PyG

toxinpred3.name: ToxinPred3
toxinpred3.selection: Evaluation of the released model; the threshold is specified through interface arguments
toxinpred3.dependencies: scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas; motif modes require additional tools

structoxnet.name: StrucToxNet
structoxnet.selection: The historical comparison corresponding to manuscript Table 2 used validation Accuracy, explicitly supplied through --select-metric; the generic CSV CLI default is MCC
structoxnet.dependencies: PyTorch, PyG, torch-scatter, torch-cluster, transformers, ProtT5, ESMFold, Biopython, mkdssp; see structoxnet/requirements.txt and environment.yml
